description: This file implements an ALSA-based audio sink class for the Starboard platform, managing audio playback, buffering, and resampling on Raspberry Pi 4 64-bit architecture.

classes.name: AlsaAudioSink
classes.description: An ALSA-based audio sink class that manages audio playback, buffering, and resampling, running in a dedicated thread.

methods.name: AlsaAudioSink
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ALSA audio sink with configuration parameters and starting the audio thread.

methods.name: ~AlsaAudioSink
methods.description: Destructor that signals thread termination and cleans up resources.

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate for the audio sink.

methods.name: SetVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume for the audio sink.

methods.name: IsType
methods.description: Checks if the sink is of a specific type.

methods.name: AudioThreadFunc
methods.description: Main function for the audio thread handling idle and playback loops.

methods.name: IdleLoop
methods.description: Handles waiting when no data is available or playback is paused, writing silence as needed.

methods.name: PlaybackLoop
methods.description: Handles pulling data from source and writing to ALSA, including resampling if playback rate differs.

methods.name: WriteFrames
methods.description: Writes audio frames to ALSA, handling resampling and buffer management.
